diagnosis: In all four rollouts, the lone decision-maker set the `sponsor_logo_displayed` to `true`, which is the default value for this fact. This default value allows the check C3 to pass without needing the hidden information PF2, which dictates the artwork file. Similarly, the `sponsor_acknowledgment_method` was set to `lockup`, which is the default value for this fact, allowing check C5 to pass without needing the hidden information PF3, which dictates the sponsor acknowledgment method.
